items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: If we have to have a producer let’s bring this guy in and then Bob James got involved

ctx.x: Well it is funny, like because at that point Gerry Mulligan had really long hair and a beard and would wear bell bottoms and stuff and I think Maynard Ferguson. I mean I think there was a lot of establishment jazz guys, instead of fighting it just started going with the flow. Hey, and to your previous question, we were talking about Dan’s groups, I just wanted to say that when I was coming out of Interlochen I met all these young very good classical musicians that also loved rock & roll. And we had school bands…

And I very consciously knew that Dave was this really popular figure in jazz and I couldn’t compete in that world but I really wanted to have a really really creative rock & roll band. And the first thing we did was the group was called The New Heavenly Blue. We did a record on RCA. And then we did a record on Atlantic. And that evolved into a group called Sky King that we did a record on Columbia. And Madcat, the great harmonica player who I still play with and who played with two generations of Brubeck, he was…
